#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace std;

bool solve(long long w, long long m);
bool trySolve(long long w, long long m);

bool solve(long long w, long long m) {
    return w <= 3 || m == 1 || trySolve(w, m-1) || trySolve(w, m) || trySolve(w, m+1);
}

bool trySolve(long long w, long long m) {
    return m % w == 0 && solve(w, m / w);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    cout.tie(NULL);
    
    long long w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    
    if (solve(w, m))
        cout << "YES" << endl;
    else
        cout << "NO" << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
